cases.name: Nikitha Godishala
cases.about:
Nikitha lived in Ellicott City, Maryland, where she worked as a data analyst. She had previously completed a pharmacy course from Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University in Hyderabad before moving to the US for a Master’s in Health Information Technology from the University of Maryland.

While police in Maryland said they did not yet know of the motive for her murder, (her father) Anand Godishala said Sharma had borrowed money from his daughter.

“He had a habit of borrowing money, and he borrowed from my daughter, too. When she asked him to return the money, I think he asked her to come to his flat, and he attacked her there and fled.
cases.narrative:
He allegedly reported her missing after he stabbed her to death and fled to India.

Police believe he killed her on New Years' Eve,
